description: This Java class 'EntityEcaUtil' manages Entity Event-Condition-Action (ECA) rules, including loading configurations, caching, and retrieving rules based on entity and event. It interacts with configuration files, resource handlers, and concurrency utilities to facilitate dynamic rule management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityEcaUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Entity ECA rules, including loading, caching, and retrieval based on entity and event.

methods.name: getEntityEcaCache
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the ECA rules cache for a given entity ECA reader name.

methods.name: getEntityEcaReaderName
methods.description: Gets the ECA reader name associated with a delegator name from configuration.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from configuration resources and populates the cache.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses XML resource to extract ECA rules.

methods.name: createEcaLoaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a callable task to load ECA rules from a resource handler.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Retrieves ECA rules for a specific entity and event from cache.
